scope: PR feature/0.4.6 -> develop, re-verdict after REJECTED 0bf7a759. Full range 7c421ead3282d5b133b0ceffd41c262dada304e6..637059d2 (merge-base origin/develop, 67 commits): dadaia ci push-gate-check denylist scan (ref-line shapes: update-existing-remote and zero-remote-sha), secret-pattern grep over every added line, dadaia public doctor, dadaia specs doctor, pip-audit delta. Targeted diff review 0bf7a759..637059d2 -- dadaia_workspace (F1 CWE-20/22/73, F2 CWE-59 closure at the seam) with live repro in a scratch workspace under .dadaia/tmp/security-reviewer/20260904/.
verdict_reason: F1 (HIGH, CWE-20/22/73) and F2 (LOW, CWE-59) are closed at one seam and reproduced closed through the real CLI: `dadaia import` refused slug '..', a slug owned by an ALIVE context (as main and as associated repo) and a name with a space, wrote nothing (registry = alpha + control record); `doctor --fix` INV-5 on a poisoned registry skipped 'repos/..', 'repos/.', a symlink out of repos/ and a symlink to a sibling checkout, removed only the genuine stale dir, and the workspace root, the outside target and the ALIVE checkout survived; a symlinked `.dadaia/handoff` zone root produced no per-entry finding and `--fix --expired-only` (the SessionStart lane) left the aged target file untouched. The only writer to JsonContextStore.save is SpecContextService.register (service.py:197); the CLI allowlist loops are deleted; CONTEXT_NAME_RE has one home. Gates: push-gate denylist exit 0 in both shapes; 0 secret-pattern hits, 0 private-key headers; public doctor [ok] public-privacy; specs doctor 0 errors; no pyproject/poetry.lock delta in range. No CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM finding; 2 LOW (one in-range CWE-706 mistarget on `--workspace`, one pre-existing CWE-59 canon classification) are non-blocking and recorded for Arm B. Bug-surface verdict: reduced — production diff 0bf7a759..HEAD is 176+/183- (net -7) with +196 test lines; the guard moved from two CLI-local loops (a3-context-create-accepts-unusable-name cb426924, context-create-accepts-slug-owned-by-another-context 3bf5824c — the prior symptom-local fixes on this seam family) into the one service seam every registry insert passes, and five regex copies collapsed to one.

findings.message: CWE-706 — `dadaia import --workspace <path>` / `dadaia export --workspace <path>` re-resolve an explicit path through the ancestor walk and write into a parent workspace (cli/commands/import_.py:30, cli/commands/export.py:29 -> core/workspace_resolver.py:57-66).
findings.detail_md:
In range: f4bf7e0b (T-046-31) introduced `container.build_import_service(resolve_workspace_root(workspace))`; `resolve_workspace_root` walks up from the given path to the first ancestor holding `.dadaia/states/spec_contexts.json` and never applies the `.dadaia/` boundary that `resolve_workspace_root_for_init(explicit=True)` / `_is_nested_inside_dotdadaia` (workspace_resolver.py:97-124) added for bug `ancestor-walk-workspace-root-silent-mistarget` (HIGH, resolved 3084f832, scoped to init + reports validate).

Reproduced by this review: `dadaia import --workspace <live>/.dadaia/tmp/security-reviewer/20260904/noinit <file>` (an uninitialized dir) exited 0 and registered two DEAD records (`thief`/slug `alpha`, `good`/slug `good-repo`) in the LIVE workspace registry (13 contexts); reverted with `dadaia context delete thief` and `dadaia context delete good` (registry back to 11, no `repos/` residue). Impact is bounded by `SpecContextService.register`: only allowlisted, unowned slugs land, as DEAD records, nothing on disk. Bug-history reading: same symptom as the resolved HIGH, on a second verb pair — the earlier fix was verb-local, which is the recurrence signature.
findings.fix_recommendation: Arm B, non-blocking. Register: `dadaia bugs append --bug-id import-export-workspace-flag-walks-to-ancestor-workspace --reported-by security-reviewer --severity LOW --surface cli --component dadaia_workspace/core/workspace_resolver.py#resolve_workspace_root ...`. Structural fix (deletion-shaped): one resolver that honors an explicit path as authoritative (raise WorkspaceNotInitializedError when it lacks the sentinel) and applies the `.dadaia/` boundary for every verb; delete the init-only `resolve_workspace_root_for_init` variant so the rule has one home. RED test: `import --workspace <uninitialized dir nested under a workspace's .dadaia/tmp>` must exit 1 and write nothing.

findings.message: CWE-59/CWE-61 — a symlinked zone root (e.g. `.dadaia/handoff -> ../repos/<victim>`) is classified `canon` by the top-level scan and never surfaced (features/spec_context/doctor.py:389-391 `_scan_dadaia_top`: `entry.is_dir()` follows the link).
findings.detail_md: Pre-existing, not widened by this range; the predecessor's observation confirmed. With `_entries` (doctor.py:305-314) refusing to walk a symlinked root, the read side is inert: reproduced — `dadaia doctor --json` on a scratch workspace with `.dadaia/handoff -> ../repos/victim` (containing `old.txt` aged 3 days) yielded `issues: []`, no finding naming `old.txt`, no finding on `handoff`, compliance 10/13; `dadaia doctor --fix --expired-only` (the SessionStart lane) seeded only the missing `agentic`/`hooks` zones, `old.txt` survived and the symlink remained. The lane cannot act on it today. Residual: a scan that reports the zone as canon hides a redirected zone root for every later reader (`--fix` seeding, future zone-level deletion, any writer that trusts the zone path).
findings.fix_recommendation: Non-blocking. In `_scan_dadaia_top`, classify `entry.is_symlink()` as SLOP with detail `(symlink)` so `--fix` routes it through `_remove` (doctor.py:596-603), which unlinks a symlink and never follows it; one-line change on the classification branch, no new path. Pin with the existing `test_a_symlinked_zone_root_is_never_walked` parametrization extended to assert one `WS-dadaia-slop` finding on the zone entry.

findings.message: CWE-59 defense-in-depth — `_remove_dead_repo` (doctor.py:537) admits `repos/<slug>` when it is a symlink to a sibling INSIDE repos/; the refusal then rests on `shutil.rmtree` raising on a symlink, reported as `INV-5: skipped 'repos/linkin' (errno None: None)`.
findings.detail_md: Reproduced: `repos/linkin -> alpha` (alpha ALIVE) with a poisoned DEAD record `linkin`; `doctor --fix` reported the errno-None skip and `repos/alpha/marker.txt` survived. Safe in CPython, but the guard's stated contract (`resolve().parent == repos/`) is satisfied and the protection is implicit and its message uninformative.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add `or repo_path.is_symlink()` to the containment predicate at doctor.py:537 so the refusal is explicit and reads `skipped 'repos/<slug>' (symlink)`; extend `test_inv5_fix_never_follows_a_symlinked_repo_dir` with the inside-repos target.

findings.message: INV-5 scan side (doctor.py:211-221) still evaluates `(repos / ctx.repo_slug).exists()` without the fix-side containment predicate: a poisoned record with slug `..` or `.` reports `Context 'x' is dead but repo '..' is on disk` (fixable=True).
findings.detail_md: Report-only false positive on a hand-edited registry (register() no longer admits such slugs); the fix side refuses (`INV-5: skipped 'repos/..' (outside repos/)`, reproduced). No exposure.
findings.fix_recommendation: Optional: share one containment predicate between the INV-5 scan and `_remove_dead_repo` so the scan reports `(slug resolves outside repos/)` instead of a fixable INV-5.

findings.message: Dependency scan — no lockfile delta in range (pyproject.toml/poetry.lock unchanged 7c421ead..HEAD); pip-audit on the workspace venv lists 32 advisories in tooling the project does not declare.
findings.detail_md: Record-only, environment-level: pillow 12.2.0 (20 PYSEC-2026 ids, fix 12.3.0), pip 24.0 (7, fix 25.3-26.2), poetry 1.8.3 (2, fix 2.3.3/2.3.4), dulwich (2), msgpack (1); `dm-capture-utils 0.1.0` skipped: not on PyPI (dependency-confusion-shaped name installed from a sibling project). None appear in this repo's poetry.lock. Evidence: `.dadaia/tmp/security-reviewer/20260904/pip-audit.txt`. gitleaks is absent from the venv and PATH — pattern grep used instead.
findings.fix_recommendation: Operator: `pip install -U pip pillow poetry` in the workspace venv on the next tooling refresh; audit the provenance of `dm-capture-utils` in the venv. No release action.

findings.message: Secrets and privacy gates — 0 secret-pattern hits and 0 private-key headers over every added line of 7c421ead..HEAD; `dadaia ci push-gate-check` exit 0 in both ref-line shapes (operator denylist + baseline); `dadaia public doctor` reports `[ok] public-privacy`.
findings.detail_md: Pattern: `(password|passwd|secret|token|api_key|apikey|private_key|aws_secret|ghp_|gho_|sk-…|AKIA…)\s*[=:]\s*['"][^'"]{6,}` plus `BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY`; the only keyword hits are `token_estimate` counters and doc text. Redaction on the two new BUGS.jsonl records checked: no absolute local path, hostname or private name.
